items: Vertical 9:16 portrait format photograph. On a light wooden table next to a bright window, a hand scrubbing a dull tarnished silver ring with a toothbrush covered in white toothpaste, a plain white unlabelled tube lying beside it, close-up. Photorealistic, soft daylight, rolled-up sleeve of a burgundy cotton shirt, no face visible. No text, no letters, no numbers, no brand names, no logos, no watermark.
